description: Requests to give the coding agent of an application built on Rapyd Admin. Shown on the Develop with AI page; `requires` lists the Composer packages a prompt needs.

prompts.title: A new section of the admin
prompts.prompt: Add a Suppliers section to the admin: a list, a detail page and a form for suppliers (name, vat number, email, phone, active). Operators can manage them.
prompts.produces: app/Modules/Suppliers with model, migration, three pages, permissions, Authorizations/, Limits/, menu entry and a feature test.

prompts.title: A lifecycle on a model
prompts.prompt: Suppliers must be approved before they can be used: a new supplier is pending, an admin approves or rejects it, a rejected one can be resubmitted. Show the state and the actions on the supplier page.
prompts.produces: workflow.php with places and transitions, a subscriber for guards and effects, the workflow embed on the detail page, tests of the transitions.

prompts.title: Extend a bundled module
prompts.prompt: Add a 'city' filter to the users list of the Auth module and show the city column.
prompts.produces: The filter and the column in the users table, keeping authorization and layout; rpd:eject only if the change needs it.

prompts.title: Sell something
prompts.prompt: Add a 'Premium support' service to the shop: yearly subscription, 290 euro, activated automatically after payment with a licence key.
prompts.produces: Product, variant and price list rows in the shop, the service item provisioned after payment, the licence generated.

prompts.title: Import a price list from Excel
prompts.prompt: Import products and prices from this Excel file into the shop, creating the categories it needs and asking me only when a row is ambiguous.
prompts.produces: Products, categories and price list rows read from the sheet, a report of the rows skipped.

prompts.title: Take payments
prompts.prompt: Customers must pay orders online with Stripe; mark the order paid when the gateway confirms and email the customer.
prompts.produces: The Stripe gateway configured, the order workflow moving to paid on the webhook, the notification.
